summary: Changed monthly admission gate from using self._train_df to self._cached_slim_val (val split). Two call sites updated: line ~2836 (in run()) and line ~3316 (in finalize_island()). notes_for_reviewer: Used self._cached_slim_val instead of self._scoped_val_df because self._scoped_val_df is set to None at the end of __init__ (line 2380) to free memory. self._cached_slim_val is preserved and has the needed label/meta columns (slim_backtest_df keeps META_COLUMNS and LABEL_COLUMNS).
